hypothesis: A broad VCP leg often contains a later, smaller line-of-least-resistance pivot whose post-pivot low provides a coherent and materially tighter structural risk level than the broad final contraction low.
candidate_deduplication: earliest signal per symbol, scale, pivot_date

representation.search_interval: broad last-low date through the completed bar before signal day
representation.micro_pivot: most recent one-bar local high confirmed by the following completed bar and below the signal-day close
representation.micro_structure_low: lowest low strictly after that micro pivot through the completed bar before signal day
representation.causal_cutoff: No signal-day high/low is used to select or confirm the micro pivot; signal-day close is used only to establish that the resistance was crossed.

outputs: broad last-leg risk from signal close
acceptance: The representation is useful only if it exists for at least 70% of unique setups, has at least 60% coverage in every full calendar year 2018-2025, and the overall median micro risk is no more than half the median broad-leg risk. Outcome labels are reported descriptively but cannot be used to change the representation.
anti_overfit: No alternate swing span, lookback window, tightness threshold, risk cutoff, stop rule, entry rule, or portfolio backtest is permitted after seeing this result.
next_if_pass: Expose the nested pivot and structure low as research evidence, then pre-register one coherent risk-sizing method. Do not alter forward-v1.
next_if_fail: Stop technical micro-pivot extraction and require external catalyst or manually labeled structure evidence before further strategy changes.
